verdict.rationale: Chroma's own docs say the Chroma CLI runs a Chroma server locally, and the product can 'Run it locally', so the lightweight-local-instance half of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack shows an embedded, in-process mode or addresses suitability for small workloads. Missing for 10: documented embedded in-process (library) mode, evidence of the local instance's footprint or fit for small workloads, independent or hands-on corroboration of local runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the database embedded in-process or as a lightweight local instance for development and small workloads

citations.quote: The Chroma CLI lets you run a Chroma server locally on your machine
Install the Chroma CLI to run a local server
Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.
